# jenkins_credential_gitlab_access_token (Resource)

Manages a GitLab access token credential within Jenkins, the "GitLab Personal Access Token" or "GitLab Group Access Token" kind of the [GitLab Branch Source Plugin](https://plugins.jenkins.io/gitlab-branch-source/).

A GitLab Project or GitLab Group branch source uses one such credential for the GitLab API, for checkout, and for pipeline status notifications. A plain username/password credential does not work for the API calls, because the plugin only reads a token from these kinds or from a secret text credential.

~> The "token" property may leave a plain-text token in your state file. If using the property to manage the token in Terraform, ensure that your state file is properly secured and encrypted at rest.

~> The Jenkins installation that uses this resource is expected to have the [GitLab Branch Source Plugin](https://plugins.jenkins.io/gitlab-branch-source/) installed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A folder-scoped GitLab group access token for the folder's GitLab branch sources.
resource "jenkins_credential_gitlab_access_token" "team" {
  name   = "gitlab-team"
  folder = jenkins_folder.team.id

  token_type       = "group"
  token_wo         = var.gitlab_group_access_token
  token_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the resource being created. This maps to the ID property within Jenkins, and cannot be changed once set.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `description` (String) A human readable description of the credentials being stored.
- `domain` (String) The domain store to place the credentials into. If not set will default to the global credentials store.
- `folder` (String) The folder namespace to store the resource in. If not set will default to global Jenkins.
- `scope` (String) The visibility of the credentials to Jenkins agents. This must be set to either "GLOBAL" or "SYSTEM". If not set will default to "GLOBAL".
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The GitLab access token.
- `token_type` (String) The credential kind: `personal` (GitLab Personal Access Token, also used for project access tokens) or `group` (GitLab Group Access Token). Both store the token the same way. Defaults to `personal`. Changing it forces a new credential.
- `token_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The GitLab access token. Write-only: the value is used only during apply and is **never stored in Terraform state or plan**. Requires Terraform >= 1.11, conflicts with `token`, and must be paired with `token_wo_version`.
- `token_wo_version` (String) Version identifier for `token_wo`. Because a write-only value is not stored in state, Terraform cannot detect when it changes; change this value (e.g. after rotating the secret) to have Terraform re-send `token_wo` to Jenkins. Required when `token_wo` is set.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The full canonical job path, e.g. `/job/job-name`
